get_experiment_config: get the config dict for a two dimensional challenging mixture distribution experiment
review_get_config: review the get_config function that returns a ConfigDict for a 2D challenging mixture experiment
summarize_get_config: summarize the get_config function and its nested optimization flow mcmc and sampler config sections
modify_flow_config: modify the flow_config nested dict to change spline bins layers or identity init settings
customize_mcmc_config: customize the mcmc_config nested dict to adjust HMC NUTS or slice sampler step parameters
